svg.aria-label: Byte offsets 0 to 32, with padding0 removed from both sides. C++ puts time, amplitude and frequency at 0, 4 and 8 and baseColor's red, green, blue and alpha at 12 to 24, ending at 28 bytes pushed. GLSL puts the same first three members there, leaves a gap at 12 because a vec4 starts on a multiple of 16, and reads baseColor.r, g, b and a at 16 to 28.
